description:
Start either a free 10-page quality probe (mode='sample', up to 10 pages/day per account) or paid full digitization (mode='full').

The book must be in status ready or sampled. mode='full' charges the full book price upfront in RUB (quote the current rate and total with estimate_book; 402 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE if balance is too low; refused if the sample verdict was reject).
Reuse idempotency_key when retrying after a network timeout so the book is not started twice. Follow progress with
get_book until status is sampled (inspect sample text via list_book_pages with sample_only=true) or done.

mode.description: sample = free quality probe on up to 10 pages; full = paid full-book digitization.
mode.title: Mode

rights_confirmed.description: Set true if rights were not already confirmed on the book; false is always refused.
rights_confirmed.title: Rights Confirmed

sample_pages.description: Optional 1-based page numbers for mode='sample' (up to 10; evenly spaced pages are picked automatically when omitted).
sample_pages.title: Sample Pages

name: start_book
